attempts.raw:
{
  "title": "Child Fitness Progress Dashboard",
  "subtitle": "Tracking physical improvements from baseline to endline by location and coach",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total Children Tracked",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT \"Child ID\") AS n FROM (SELECT \"Child ID\" FROM \"baseline\" UNION SELECT \"Child ID\" FROM \"endline\") AS all_children",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Avg Shuttle Run Improvement",
      "sql": "SELECT AVG(e.\"Shuttle run sec\" - b.\"Shuttle run sec\") AS avg_improvement FROM \"baseline\" b JOIN \"endline\" e ON b.\"Child ID\" = e.\"Child ID\"",
      "unit": "sec"
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Avg Sit Ups Gain",
      "sql": "SELECT AVG(e.\"Sit ups\" - b.\"Sit ups\") AS avg_gain FROM \"baseline\" b JOIN \"endline\" e ON b.\"Child ID\" = e.\"Child ID\"",
      "unit": "reps"
    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Top Locations by Shuttle Run Improvement",
      "sql": "SELECT b.\"Location\", AVG(b.\"Shuttle run sec\" - e.\"Shuttle run sec\") AS improvement_sec FROM \"baseline\" b JOIN \"endline\" e ON b.\"Child ID\" = e.\"Child ID\" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10",
      "x": "location",
      "y": ["improvement_sec"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p5",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Top Coaches by Sit Ups Gain",
      "sql": "SELECT b.\"Coach\", AVG(e.\"Sit ups\" - b.\"Sit ups\") AS gain_reps FROM \"baseline\" b JOIN \"endline\" e ON b.\"Child ID\" = e.\"Child ID\" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10",
      "x": "coach",
      "y": ["gain_reps"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p6",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "Detailed Progress by Location and Coach",
      "sql": "SELECT b.\"Location\", b.\"Coach\", COUNT(*) AS child_count, ROUND(AVG(b.\"Shuttle run sec\" - e.\"Shuttle run sec\"), 2) AS shuttle_improvement, ROUND(AVG(e.\"Sit ups\" - b.\"Sit ups\"), 1) AS situp_gain FROM \"baseline\" b JOIN \"endline\" e ON b.\"Child ID\" = e.\"Child ID\" GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 20",
      "columns": ["location", "coach", "child_count", "shuttle_improvement", "situp_gain"]
    }
  ],
  "narrative": "This dashboard tracks the physical fitness progress of children across various locations and coaches. A total of {{p1}} children were tracked from their baseline measurements to their endline results.\n\nOn average, children improved their shuttle run times by {{p2}} seconds, indicating better speed and agility. Additionally, there was an average increase of {{p3}} sit-ups per child, reflecting gains in core strength.\n\nThe top-performing locations show significant improvements in shuttle run times, with the leading location achieving an average improvement of {{p4.improvement_sec}} seconds. Similarly, specific coaches have driven notable gains in sit-up performance, with the top coach's group averaging a gain of {{p5.gain_reps}} reps."
}

  "title": "Gender Equity in Physical Progress",
  "subtitle": "Comparing baseline to endline performance improvements between boys and girls",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total Girls Tracked",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM "baseline" WHERE "Gender" = 'Female' UNION SELECT "Child ID" FROM "endline" WHERE "Gender" = 'Female') AS unique_girls",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total Boys Tracked",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM "baseline" WHERE "Gender" = 'Male' UNION SELECT "Child ID" FROM "endline" WHERE "Gender" = 'Male') AS unique_boys",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Avg Shuttle Run Improvement (Seconds)",
      "sql": "WITH combined AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Gender", "Shuttle run sec" AS baseline_val, NULL AS endline_val FROM "baseline"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "Child ID", "Gender", NULL AS baseline_val, "Shuttle run sec" AS endline_val FROM "endline"
),
matched AS (
  SELECT 
    c1."Gender",
    c1.baseline_val,
    c2.endline_val,
    (c1.baseline_val - c2.endline_val) AS improvement_sec
  FROM combined c1
  JOIN combined c2 ON c1."Child ID" = c2."Child ID" AND c1."Gender" = c2."Gender"
  WHERE c1.baseline_val IS NOT NULL AND c2.endline_val IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT "Gender", AVG(improvement_sec) AS avg_improvement FROM matched GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC",

      "y": ["avg_improvement"]

  UNION ALL
  SELECT "Child ID", "Gender", NULL AS baseline_val, "Sit ups" AS endline_val FROM "endline"
),
matched AS (
  SELECT 
    c1."Gender",
    c1.baseline_val,
    c2.endline_val,
    (c2.endline_val - c1.baseline_val) AS improvement_count

  JOIN combined c2 ON c1."Child ID" = c2."Child ID" AND c1."Gender" = c2."Gender"
  WHERE c1.baseline_val IS NOT NULL AND c2.endline_val IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT "Gender", AVG(improvement_count) AS avg_improvement FROM matched GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC",

      "y": ["avg_improvement"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p5",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "Top 10 Improvers by Gender",

  SELECT "Child ID", "Gender", "Shuttle run sec" AS baseline_val, NULL AS endline_val FROM "baseline"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "Child ID", "Gender", NULL AS baseline_val, "Shuttle run sec" AS endline_val FROM "endline"
),
matched AS (
  SELECT 
    c1."Child ID",
    c1."Gender",
    c1.baseline_val,
    c2.endline_val,

      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Average Shuttle Run Improvement (sec)",
      "sql": "WITH combined AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Gender", "Shuttle run sec" AS baseline_val, 'baseline' AS phase FROM "baseline"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "Child ID", "Gender", "Shuttle run sec" AS endline_val, 'endline' AS phase FROM "endline"
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT 
    "Child ID",
    "Gender",
    MAX(CASE WHEN phase = 'baseline' THEN baseline_val END) AS b_val,
    MAX(CASE WHEN phase = 'endline' THEN endline_val END) AS e_val
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY "Child ID", "Gender"
)
SELECT AVG(e_val - b_val) AS avg_improvement FROM pivot WHERE b_val IS NOT NULL AND e_val IS NOT NULL",
      "unit": "sec"
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "bar",

  SELECT "Child ID", "Gender", "Sit ups" AS val, 'baseline' AS phase FROM "baseline"

    MAX(CASE WHEN phase = 'endline' THEN val END) AS e_val
  FROM combined

)
SELECT 
  "Gender",
